light.motifs: Heatmor furnace engineering: red armor with raised yellow dented bands; tubular vent motifs and compact exhaust piping integrated into armor, a controlled flame-shaped chest aperture.

casual1.scene: Folded towels and a ceramic soap dish line the tiled bathroom beneath warm mirror bulbs in 2010.
casual1.outfit: A soft cropped strapless knit sweater with an open back, paired with charcoal leggings, exposing shoulders and the back.

why.outfit: 계획의 니트 상의·레깅스를 유지하며 스트랩리스·등 파임을 적용한다.

casual2.scene: Amber and violet karaoke lights graze the upholstered booths and a small stage monitor.
casual2.outfit: An adult Heatmor costume in a high-cut red bodysuit with sheer thigh-high tights, raised yellow band decorations, a one-shoulder cut and an exposed midriff.

why.scene: 선택된 노래방을 앤티골의 코스튬 무대로 구체화한다.
why.outfit: 선택된 바디수트 코스튬에 계획의 원숄더·허리 노출을 적용한다.

casual3.scene: An evening grocery aisle is lined with chilled drinks and baskets under fluorescent shelf lights.
casual3.outfit: A cropped kebaya-inspired sheer lace top with floral embroidery over an opaque fitted camisole, with side cutouts exposing the waist and midriff.

why.scene: 선택된 마트의 진열대와 저녁 조명을 보완한다.
why.outfit: 크바야 응용 레이스를 유지하고 크롭·옆 트임을 반영한다.
